item.title: India bonds track Treasury weakness ahead of debt supply
item.description: Indian government bonds are currently facing losses as traders brace for an influx of debt supply and mounting inflation pressures. The 10-year US Treasury yield is nearing the 5% mark, fueled by predictions of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes in December. With India's retail inflation climbing to 6.09%, expectations rise for further rate adjustments by the Reserve Bank of India.

item.title: Punjab National Bank among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 22% in a month
item.description: Four BSE 100 stocks, including Punjab National Bank, Federal Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, hit fresh 52-week highs, with monthly gains ranging from 10% to 22%.
